Ana: Quick sync request — vendor roadmap call scheduled Wed 09:30 PT with Nvidia, AMD, and Habana (Gaudi). Need to lock joint announce windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Primary asks: embargo windows, marketplace listing lead times, and fallback variants if HW delayed.
Mike: Do we want a single unified press window or staggered waves? I lean staggered by vendor to avoid embargo pileups. :thinking: 
Jin: Marketplace note — we need 6 business days to onboard SKUs + images and at least one validated AMI/manifest. If we want GA on the same day as public PR, earliest intake is next Mon.
Leo: Risk to call out: B200 firmware still in vendor QA in our lab. Contingency assumption: B200 could slip ~2 weeks. Suggest fallback mapping from B200 -> H200-compatible runtime in the playbook.
Sarah: Legal/comms heads up — PR needs 48h legal review. Can we do an early "developer preview" mention for the marketplace beta to buy time? :+1: 
Ana: Proposed timeline (tentative):
```
- Wed AM: vendor sync (confirm embargo windows)
- Thu: internal readiness + ops runbook finalization
- Fri: legal + comms signoff on PR language
- Mon: marketplace preflight + SKU intake
- Tue: public announce (vendor A, vendor B staggered)
- Wed: Gaudi/partner announcement follow-up
```
Mike: Assignments:
- Ana: run vendor sync & capture embargo windows
- Jin: open marketplace ticket + manifest checklist
- Leo: draft ops fallback playbook + small config snippets for runtime mapping
- Sarah: draft PR templates (unified + staggered) and legal intake

partner-bot: Calendar invite created: https://cal.company/1726001234 — attendees: Ana, Mike, Jin, Leo, Sarah
Ana: Any blockers? If B200 firmware slips >3 weeks we should pre-announce H200 & MI300 first and mark B200 as "coming soon" to avoid user disappointment.
Jin: Noted — I'll add a marketplace soft-tag option to hide B200 SKU until image validation completes.
Leo: Will paste a quick `runbook.md` snippet into the thread by EOD with the fallback commands and env flags.
Sarah: I'll prepare two PR drafts (unified + staggered) and share by EOD for legal to pick.
Ana: Thanks — if no objections I'll run the vendor sync and post a follow-up with embargo windows and exact announce dates.
Mike: :thumbsup:
